summary_en: DENSO authorized acquisition of up to 100 million shares (3.99% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 20 billion yen through on-market purchases from October 30, 2026 through March 31, 2027, as part of capital structure improvement and shareholder returns aligned with its medium-term plan.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On October 29, 2026, DENSO Corporation's board of directors approved a share buyback program authorizing the acquisition of up to 100 million shares (representing 3.99% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum consideration of 20 billion yen. Purchases will be made through on-market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between October 30, 2026 and March 31, 2027.

The buyback is part of DENSO's capital strategy under its medium-term plan CORE 2030, which aims to maximize both social value and capital efficiency. The company's financial strategy includes four pillars: strengthening profitability, compressing low-return assets, improving capital structure, and engaging in market dialogue. The buyback will be executed based on the company's basic policy of improving capital composition while maintaining an equity ratio not exceeding 60%, with acquisition decisions made dynamically through comparison with theoretical share prices.

The company noted that this buyback is separate from the off-market acquisition of approximately 31 billion yen of DENSO shares held by Toyota Industries Corporation, which was announced on April 28, 2026. Going forward, DENSO intends to continue implementing share buybacks dynamically in accordance with the same policy while prioritizing growth investments.
